content.name: Liam Tran
content.title: Graduate Software Developer
content.summary: Graduate developer in the second year of a rotation programme, writing Python and Django services for an online learning platform used by 90 Queensland schools. Rebuilt the assignment-upload flow so it no longer fails on slow school networks. Keen on testing, accessibility and clear documentation.

experience.title: Summer Software Developer Intern
bullets: Created a Python script that matched pallet scans against delivery manifests, flagging mismatches that warehouse staff had been checking by hand for 90 minutes a shift.
Wrote pytest coverage for the depot-routing module and documented its setup, so the next intern got a working environment in one morning rather than three days.
Demoed the manifest checker to the operations manager, who rolled it out to two more depots.

experience.title: Graduate Software Developer
bullets: Rebuilt assignment uploads in Django with resumable chunked transfers, dropping failed submissions from roughly 8% to under 1% across 90 schools.
Added keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels to the student dashboard after testing with NVDA, closing 37 WCAG 2.1 AA issues from an external audit.
Built a Celery task that sends teachers a daily digest of late work, now opened by about 2,300 teachers each week.
Rotated through the platform team for three months, writing Terraform for a staging environment that costs $1,200 a month less than the old one.

education.degree: Bachelor of Information Technology (Computer Science major)
education.details: GPA 6.2/7. Capstone: timetable clash detector for a community sports league.
ATAR 91.40. Digital Solutions, Mathematical Methods, Physics.

achievements.title: Peer mentor, QUT IT faculty
